description: UMW NE555 — precision timer IC, 4.5-16V supply, up to 100kHz astable operation. SOP-8 package. The classic 555 timer for monostable/astable multivibrator, PWM generation, missing-pulse detection, and pulse-width modulation.
name: ne555
watch_out_for: Bipolar (not CMOS) — output can source/sink 200mA. Reset pin (active low) must be tied to VCC if unused. Control voltage pin should have 10nF to GND for noise immunity. Timing accuracy depends on capacitor quality — use film or NP0/C0G ceramic for timing. TLC555 (CMOS version) preferred for low-power/battery applications.
